strings.en: Archie

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()アーチー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()あーちー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)静内さやかの守護獣。属性は海。見た目通り弓術の達人。マスターに似ず、忠実に命令を守る無口な守護獣。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Archie&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Sayaka Shizunai's Guardian.&n()Element: Sea. A master archer,&n()as it looks. Unlike its Master, a&n()quiet Guardian that faithfully&n()obeys orders.
Amazon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Amazon Adult&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Guardian of&n()the Egubado strike force. Its&n()roller-like hind legs give it real&n()running speed.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Amazon Cub&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. The lower class&n()of the Amazon Adult. Upper or&n()lower class seems to depend on&n()the Master's potential.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Amazon Youth&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Youth is one&n()step short of an Adult.&n()Naturally, its abilities fall&n()between the two.
Hornram

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Hornram&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A Guardian of&n()the Egubado strike force. Its&n()body slam packs a punch.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Heavy Hornram&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. An upgraded&n()Hornram with more attack&n()power and toughness.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Scout Hornram&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A Hornram for&n()patrol duty, a bit faster than&n()the regular kind.
Ur

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()ウール&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()うーる&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)半澤由美の守護獣。属性は海。メールと違い足を持つため陸上も苦にしない。好戦的な外観通り攻撃力が高い。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Ur&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Yumi Hanzawa's Guardian.&n()Element: Sea. Unlike Mer it has&n()legs, so land is no trouble. As&n()warlike as it looks, with high&n()attack power.
Shadow Oni

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Shadow Oni&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A Guardian of&n()the Egubado raider force. An&n()assassin Guardian, like the&n()Mechaninja.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Mutant Shadow&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. A Shadow Oni of&n()another element. Now and then&n()it appears when a Shadow Oni&n()control piercing is used.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Hex Shadow&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A Shadow Oni&n()with stronger assassin skills. It&n()can snuff out a foe in a single&n()blow.
Flame Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Flame Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Koen's awakened form: Mayu&n()Homura's Guardian. Element:&n()Flame. Wrapped all over in fire,&n()it boasts high defense.
Gara

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()ガーラー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()がーらー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)一の宮琴音の守護獣。属性は炎。マスターとは反対にイケイケの女性型守護獣。ドーガーとコンビで戦う。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Gara&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Kotone Ichinomiya's Guardian.&n()Element: Flame. Unlike her&n()Master, a gung-ho female&n()Guardian. Fights as a team with&n()Doga.
Sea Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Sea Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Mer's awakened form: Misato&n()Kaibara's Guardian. Element: Sea.&n()As before its awakening, it&n()excels at fighting on water.
Gao

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Gao&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Chikana Suo's Guardian. Element:&n()Earth. Truly the guardian god of&n()the noble Kamikado bloodline,&n()with great fighting power.
Haze Blade

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Haze Blade&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. Rear support for&n()the defense force. It carries a&n()sword, but its main job is&n()healing its allies.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()褐装陽炎剣士&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()かっしょうかげろうけんし&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は聖。褐色の衣をまとった陽炎剣士。ノーマルタイプよりやや打たれ強い。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Brown Haze Blade&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. A Haze Blade clad&n()in brown, a bit tougher than the&n()normal type.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Twin Haze Blade&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. A Haze Blade with&n()high fighting power and a&n()specialty: the double slash.
Fossil Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Fossil Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. The Guardian&n()seen most in the Egubado strike&n()force. A common soldier, but a&n()very durable one.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()水式化石竜&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()すいしきかせきりゅう&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は海。属性が示す通り、海上戦用の化石竜。水上でも移動力を損なわず移動できる。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Aqua Fossil&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. As its element&n()says, a Fossil Dragon for sea&n()battles. It loses no movement on&n()water.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Fossil Dragon II&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. An upgraded&n()version of the regular Fossil&n()Dragon.
Kanetsugu

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()カネツグ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()かねつぐ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)直江巴澄の守護獣。属性は冥。その武者装束のイメージ通り戦闘能力は極めて高い。素早さのみやや低め。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Kanetsugu&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Hasumi Naoe's Guardian. Element:&n()Nether. As its warrior garb&n()suggests, a superb fighter. Only&n()its speed is a little low.
Scythe Lizard
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Scythe Lizard&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sky. The Guardian seen&n()most in the Egubado air force.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Scythe Lizard+&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sky. A slightly&n()powered-up Scythe Lizard. Not&n()much different.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()炎熱鎌蜥蜴&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()えんねつかまとかげ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は炎。ただの属性違いの鎌蜥蜴というわけではなく、朱雀直属のかなり高性能な守護獣。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Blaze Lizard&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. Not just a&n()Scythe Lizard of another&n()element: a high-grade Guardian&n()under Suzaku herself.
Toon Husk

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Toon Husk&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. The Guardian&n()of the elite troops under Hitomi&n()Jin. Quite high fighting power.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()戯画骸・下位族&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()ぎがむくろ・かいぞく&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は冥。適性のため戯画骸本来のパワーが出し切れない闘士たちの守護獣。そこそこ強力。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Lesser Husk&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. The Guardian&n()of Warriors whose aptitude&n()can't draw out a Toon Husk's full&n()power. Still fairly strong.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Husk Zero&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A custom Toon&n()Husk, with more fighting power&n()than the normal type.
Mechaninja

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Mechaninja&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. Like its name, it&n()closes in with ninja speed and&n()deals death. A Guardian of the&n()raider force.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Mechaninja Lo&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. The lower class of&n()Mechaninja. Even so, far&n()stronger than an average&n()Guardian.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Mechaninja Hi&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. The upper class&n()of Mechaninja. Upper or lower&n()depends on the aptitude of the&n()one wearing the control&n()piercing.
Kirara

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()きらら&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()きらら&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)平泉るりの守護獣。属性は雷。身体にまとう電気で常に防護フィールドを形成しているため、防御力が高い。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Kirara&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Ruri Hiraizumi's Guardian.&n()Element: Thunder. The&n()electricity on its body keeps up&n()a constant force field, so its&n()defense is high.
Bone Boxer

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Bone Boxer&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. Often summoned&n()by defense force captains.&n()Excellent defense and&n()toughness.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Swift Bone Boxer&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A Bone Boxer&n()with better mobility, once its&n()weak point.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()黒色拳闘骸骨&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()こくしょくけんとうがいこつ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は冥。長距離戦闘力を強化した暗黒色の拳闘骸骨。浮遊砲台と化し、侵入者を撃退する。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Black Bone Boxer&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A pitch-black&n()Bone Boxer built for long range.&n()It becomes a floating gun turret&n()that repels intruders.
Genbu

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Genbu&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Megumi Hokuto's Guardian.&n()Element: Earth. Its selling point:&n()an ironclad defense. Ordinary&n()attacks don't leave a scratch.
Koen

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()コウエン&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()こうえん&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)炎真由の守護獣。属性は炎。伝説の魔人イフリートをそのまま具現化したような姿をしている。防御力が高い。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Koen&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Mayu Homura's Guardian.&n()Element: Flame. It looks like the&n()legendary djinn Ifrit made flesh.&n()High defense.
Shellmech

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Shellmech&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A&n()ranged-combat Guardian of the&n()Egubado strike force. It looks&n()like a robot.
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Gunner Shellmech&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A Shellmech for&n()even longer range.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Support Shellmech&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. A Shellmech that&n()heals its allies as well as fighting&n()at range.
Black Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Black Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Hitomi Jin's Guardian. Element:&n()Nether. An all-rounder that&n()excels at both melee and ranged&n()combat.
Goho Doji

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()護法童子&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()ごほうどうじ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)武神の守護獣。属性は天。性能はかなり高く、四門将守護獣と互角に渡り合えるほどのパワーを持つ。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Goho Doji&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Takegami's Guardian. Element:&n()Sky. Very capable, with the&n()power to go toe to toe with the&n()Four Gate Generals' Guardians.
Saiki

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Saiki&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Yui Iwamizawa's Guardian.&n()Element: Holy. A strangely&n()chatty Guardian. Everyone&n()adores her as "Hime-chan."
Zabi-tan

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()ザビたん&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()ざびたん&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)雷晶の守護獣。属性は雷。非物質的な感じの肉体を持つため防御力に欠けるが、素早い動きでそれを補う。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Zabi-tan&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Akira Ikazuchi's Guardian.&n()Element: Thunder. Its ghostly&n()body lacks defense, but its quick&n()moves make up for it.
Slash Oni

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Slash Oni&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A Guardian of&n()the Egubado defense force. It&n()cuts intruders down with quick&n()moves.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Slash Oni+&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A powered-up&n()Slash Oni. Its even quicker&n()moves bewilder the enemy.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Slash Oni II+&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. Shores up the&n()Slash Oni's weak point, defense,&n()but is a little slower.
Gravekeeper

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Gravekeeper&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A base-defense&n()Guardian summoned by Egubado&n()officers. Quite strong.
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Grave Chief&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. More warlike&n()than the normal Gravekeeper.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Grave Envoy&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Nether. A base-defense&n()Gravekeeper made more mobile.&n()It is a little less durable for it.
True Ryuki

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()True Ryuki&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Emperor. Ryukihi fused&n()with her Guardian, Ryuki. It&n()appeared to destroy all things&n()and purify them.
Suzaku

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Suzaku&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Tomomi Nanjo's Guardian.&n()Element: Flame. Very fast, and&n()the only one of the Four Gate&n()Generals' Guardians that fights&n()in the air.
Holy Dragon

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()聖龍&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()せいりゅう&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)聖ゆかりの守護獣・ノルトの覚醒後の形態。属性は聖。巨大な翼で戦場を飛び回り、傷ついた者を癒やしていく。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Holy Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Nord's awakened form: Yukari&n()Hijiri's Guardian. Element: Holy.&n()It flies over the battlefield on&n()huge wings, healing the&n()wounded.
Seiryu

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Seiryu&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Satomi Azuma's Guardian.&n()Element: Sea. Superb attack&n()power: it can wipe out a foe in&n()one blow.
Zeku

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Zeku&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Ran Hinokage's Guardian.&n()Element: Thunder. Fast on its&n()feet and light in its moves.&n()Humanoid, but it seems it can't&n()speak.
Twin-Gun Crab

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Twin-Gun Crab&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A gun-turret&n()Guardian, as you can see. Often&n()summoned by strike force&n()captains.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Long Gun Crab&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A Twin-Gun Crab&n()with longer maximum range. Its&n()other abilities are about the&n()same.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Sea Gun Crab&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. A Twin-Gun Crab&n()for water battles, often&n()summoned by navy captains.
Earth Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Earth Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Pochi's awakened form: Yuko&n()Daichi's Guardian. Element:&n()Earth. Truly a dragon, brimming&n()with weight.
Tenaga

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Tenaga&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. A ranged-combat&n()Guardian of the Egubado strike&n()force. As its name says, it&n()attacks by stretching its arms.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()手那賀・長肢型&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()てなが・ちょうしけい&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は海。ノーマルの手那賀よりさらに遠くまで前肢が伸ばせる遠距離戦用の守護獣。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Long Tenaga&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. A long-range&n()Guardian whose arms stretch&n()even farther than a normal&n()Tenaga's.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Land Tenaga&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Tenaga for&n()land battles. Its fighting power&n()is about the same as the normal&n()type.
Ten-chan

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Ten-chan&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Miyuki Amagi's Guardian, element&n()Sky. Named for its tail, which&n()looks like shrimp tempura.
Sky Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Sky Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Ten-chan's awakened form:&n()Miyuki Amagi's Guardian. Element:&n()Sky. It has grown a look worthy&n()of the name "dragon."
Doga

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()ドーガー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()どーがー&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)一の宮鈴音の守護獣。属性は聖。マスターとは反対に物静かな性格の男性型守護獣。ガーラーとコンビで戦う。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Doga&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Suzune Ichinomiya's Guardian.&n()Element: Holy. Unlike his Master,&n()a quiet male Guardian. Fights as&n()a team with Gara.
Donald

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Donald&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Ryoko Kagami's Guardian.&n()Element: Sky. Usually only&n()doll-sized, but it bewilders foes&n()with its special power:&n()transformation.
Nagi

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()凪&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()なぎ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)飛知和景子の守護獣。属性は飛。高速で空を飛ぶことができる。マスターの性格のためか、あまり戦闘向きでは無いようだ。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Nagi&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Keiko Hichiwa's Guardian.&n()Element: Wind. It can fly at high&n()speed. Maybe due to its&n()Master's nature, it isn't much of&n()a fighter.
Nue

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()ぬえ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()ぬえ&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)四門将４体の守護獣が合体したすさまじい破壊力を持つ化物。その属性は身体の部位により四門将４種類の属性に分かれる。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Nue&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)A monster of terrible&n()destructive power, formed from&n()the Four Gate Generals' four&n()Guardians. Each body part has&n()one of their four elements.
Nord

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Nord&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Yukari Hijiri's Guardian. Element:&n()Holy. True to its angelic looks, it&n()excels at healing. Its fighting&n()power is a bit low.
Bomb Drake

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()爆竜&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()ばくりゅう&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は地。荏狗覇菟攻撃部隊の隊長クラスが召喚する守護獣。防御力、耐久力にぬきんでている上、巨体による突進も強力。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Bomb Drake&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Guardian&n()summoned by Egubado strike&n()force captains. Superb defense&n()and toughness, and a mighty&n()charge with its huge body.

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()軽機動爆竜&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()けいきどうばくりゅう&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)属性は地。爆竜に若干のスピードアップを施したもの。その代わりに防御力と耐久力がやや低下している。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Light Bomb Drake&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Bomb Drake&n()made a little faster, at the cost&n()of some defense and toughness.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Assault Drake&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Bomb Drake&n()built for combat. Strong, hard&n()and slow: a Guardian with the&n()full set.
Wing Wraith

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Wing Wraith&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. Often summoned&n()by Egubado air force captains.&n()One of the few flying Guardians.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Violet Wraith&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. A slightly tougher&n()body than the normal Wing&n()Wraith.
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Green Wraith&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. A Wing Wraith&n()with stronger ranged combat.
Byakko

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Byakko&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Reiko Saionji's Guardian.&n()Element: Thunder. A mighty&n()Guardian with both quick moves&n()and high attack power.
Wind Dragon

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Wind Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Nagi's awakened form: Keiko&n()Hichiwa's Guardian. Element:&n()Wind. Now that it has grown&n()arms, its form is built for battle.
Fudo

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Fudo&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Kaoru Kodomari's Guardian.&n()Element: Wind. Chatty Guardian&n()No. 2. It soars through the sky&n()on its sword like a surfboard.
Pochi

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Pochi&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Yuko Daichi's Guardian. Element:&n()Earth. High attack and defense,&n()just as it looks. Its flaw: it's a&n()little slow.
Centipede

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Sea Centipede&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. A Guardian of the&n()Egubado navy. Very fast, it&n()closes in from surprising&n()distances.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Flying Centipede&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Wind. A Sea Centipede&n()of another element. Apart from&n()that, its abilities are about the&n()same.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Earth Centipede&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Earth. A Sea Centipede&n()of another element. Apart from&n()that, its abilities are about the&n()same.
Mer

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()メール&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()めーる&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)海原美里の守護獣。属性は海。いわゆる人魚形態で下半身が魚のようになってる。そのため、陸上ではやや動きがにぶい。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Mer&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Misato Kaibara's Guardian.&n()Element: Sea. A mermaid form:&n()its lower half is like a fish's, so&n()it is a bit sluggish on land.
Bowman

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Bowman&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. A ranged-combat&n()Guardian, as you can see. It is&n()also a healer.
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Sniper Bowman&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Holy. Longer maximum&n()range than the normal Bowman.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Volt Bowman&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A Bowman&n()purely for ranged combat:&n()healing cut, attack power&n()raised.
Thunder Dragon

strings.jp: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()雷龍&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()らいりゅう&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)雷晶の守護獣・ザビたんの覚醒後の形態。属性は雷。以前の面影をまったく残さぬ完全な龍形態となった。
strings.en: &s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Thunder Dragon&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Zabi-tan's awakened form: Akira&n()Ikazuchi's Guardian. Element:&n()Thunder. Not a trace of its old&n()self: a perfect dragon form.
Landshark

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Aqua Landshark&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sea. A Guardian of the&n()Egubado navy, like the Aqua&n()Fossil.
&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Volt Landshark&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Thunder. A Guardian of&n()the Egubado strike force.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Flame Landshark&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Flame. A Landshark a&n()bit tougher than the Aqua and&n()Volt types.
Ryuki

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Ryuki&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Ryukihi's Guardian. Element:&n()Emperor. The strongest&n()Guardian, nearly maxed in every&n()ability. Only the Seven Dragons&n()can stand against it.
Dragonbane

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Dragonbane&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sky. A Guardian of&n()Ryukihi's Royal Guard. As its&n()name says, its mission is to&n()destroy the Seven Dragons.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Dragonbane+&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sky. A stronger&n()Dragonbane, said to match even&n()the Four Gate Generals'&n()Guardians.

&s(64,20)&g(14,32)&c(0)&e()Deathbane&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&g(0,-14)&n()&f(20,0)&g(13,30)&c(1)&e()&d()&c(2)&n()&g(14,24)&f(14,10)Element: Sky. Made to destroy&n()the Seven Dragons: it can finish&n()off any Guardian in one blow.
